'''Queg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he was a member of the [[Talons]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] and was present in [[Landing Bay 216]], the Talons' base of operations, when the [[Heroes of Cularin]] traveled there in search of the Talons' leader, [[Seng Windrunner]].
